ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity (cream/white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, roughly ovoid high-intensity (cream) regions situated on the lateral lobes. The left region contains a cluster of approximately five distinct dark circular pixel blobs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal pixel angle of 140 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge with higher frequency and pixel-amplitude variations (jaggedness) observed towards the distal tips compared to the medial region.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curve extending from the median notch to the lateral distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of textured white/grey circular pixel groups localized at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible across the light-pigmented regions; specifically two parallel diagonal marks on the left lobe and one prominent diagonal mark on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white textured clusters on distal fluke tips and multiple dark linear abrasions crossing high-intensity regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique configuration of five small dark circular spots localized within the light-pigmented region of the left lobe.
